## Summary

Explain the problem and the resulting behavior.

## Validation

List commands actually run and their results: tests, smoke script, any consumer contract.

## Evidence safety

Describe effects on what counts as a pass: generation, completeness, mutant detection, receipts.

- [ ] Tests cover the behavior at the affected boundary, with real Quint where it matters.
- [ ] Documentation and limits describe public changes.
- [ ] Claims distinguish measured results from expectations.
